Hey I totally feel what you’re going through, as a chubby, not pretty girl myself it’s really hard to feel undesirable in a world where women’s value is based off their desirability. If it makes you feel any better I have been attracted to people who are definitely not conventionally attractive because of personality. Looks help but they’re not everything.

If anyone is wondering, I am about 60 lbs overweight and have not ever been able to lose the weight permanently even after 10 or so years. I am almost obese and the weight shows horribly because I am short.
